Hi Ethan — great to hear the demo landed well. I reviewed the forecast; useful detail, thanks for sending. Below is an operational proposal tailored for a beta -> public ramp. It focuses on monthly committed tokens (hosted API) with defined step-ups and a simple true-up.

High-level proposal (monthly):
- Month 0 (Nov — closed beta): 250M committed tokens @ base rate $0.000060/token
- Month 1 (Dec — extended beta/prelaunch): 500M committed tokens @ $0.000055/token
- Month 2 (Jan — launch month): 1.5B committed tokens @ $0.000045/token
- Month 3 (Feb — peak surge window): 3.0B committed tokens @ $0.000040/token
- Month 4+ (Mar onwards): transition to a 3-month rolling commit with volume bands, e.g., 3B–6B at $0.000038, 6B+ at $0.000035 (we can finalize bands based on real usage)

Key terms & mechanics:
- Step-up flexibility: you can increase monthly commits at any time; price applies pro rata to the new commit for the remainder of the billing month. No penalty for increases.
- True-up: at month end, if usage > commit, overage billed at the overage rate (10% premium to the committed tier price) unless you’ve purchased burst protection (see below).
- Burst protection: for launch surges we can provide a short-term burst buffer (30–90 days) that caps overage exposure up to an agreed % of commit. This is a paid add-on and recommended for Feb surge.
- Refunds/cancellations: reductions to commit must be requested 14 days before month start; otherwise they apply next month.
- Forecast-linked credits: we’ll include one-time surge credits (applied post-launch) if actual traffic exceeds forecast by >30% in a month and you provide telemetry for analysis.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm which months you want burst protection and the buffer size (e.g., +50% of commit for Feb).
2) If the schedule above looks reasonable, I’ll loop in Ben with a formal offer + pricing PDF for signature and propose DocuSign next steps for procurement.

Looping in Ben and Marissa for the formal offer & approvals.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
